title: HostedMCP dataset: MCP servers, agent skills and Claude Code plugins
description: An open dataset of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, agent skills (folders with a SKILL.md) and Claude Code plugins, with automated security checks scores, categories and summaries. Exported every week from HostedMCP; every row links to its page on hostedmcp.org. Names, links, stars and other facts come from GitHub, the MCP Registry, npm and PyPI; each project keeps its own license, and no project code or README text is included.
